title: フクキタル来れば福来たる

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm out to meet up with Matikanefukukitaru on my day off, when…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Gyahhhhh!
choice_data_list: What's wrong?!
What's wrong?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: F-finally! It really happened! I got ten "great fortunes" in a row from my fortune slip key chain!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: This racewear must be boosting my good luck! No doubt about it!
choice_data_list: You think your racewear helped?
You think your racewear helped?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Of course! With all these four-leaf clovers, amulets, and good-luck charms, this racewear is packed with fortune!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I was going to give it a spin around town to test out its power, but I think it's already good to go!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I'd like to put this overwhelming abundance of luck to good use today!
choice_data_list: Maybe you could help someone out?
Maybe you could help someone out?
Give me some of that luck, please!
Give me some of that luck, please!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I'd like to put this overwhelming abundance of luck to good use today!
choice_data_list: Maybe you could help someone out?
Maybe you could help someone out?
Give me some of that luck, please!
Give me some of that luck, please!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Ooh, that's a great idea! Now to find someone in need of some help…

text_block_list.name: Young Girl
text_block_list.text: Sniffle… Wh-what should I do?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Whoa! I didn't think it'd be that easy!

text_block_list.name: Young Girl
text_block_list.text: Sob! Where did he go?! Lucky! Where are you?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After asking the young girl a few questions, we learn that she accidentally let go of her pet dog's leash during their walk.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: With a name like Lucky, this can only be the work of fate!
choice_data_list: This definitely sounds like a job for you.
This definitely sounds like a job for you.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Matikanefukukitaru is on the job! I'll find your little Lucky in no time!

text_block_list.name: Young Girl
text_block_list.text: R-really?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: You can count on it! Luck follows me wherever I go, so little Lucky should be no different!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Dogs get along with other dogs, and I just happen to have a lion-dog charm in my bag! You know, like the statues you see at all the shrines!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Now to commence the divination! I'll just put this here, and… Woof, woof! Bow wow! Shiba Inu, Chow Chow!

text_block_list.name: Shiba Inu
text_block_list.text: Pitter, patter… Chomp!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Gyahhhhh! Hey, gimme back my lion-dog!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A Shiba Inu suddenly runs up, snatches up the lion-dog charm, and scampers off.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: …Wait! That dog has a leash on it!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: What if that's Lucky?! Let's hurry and find out!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We give chase, following Lucky until he plants himself down just outside of a shopping mall.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Hmm… If we get any closer, Lucky might run into the mall and cause a scene…
choice_data_list: Do you have any animal-summoning charms?
Do you have any animal-summoning charms?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Hmmm… I have a spell that can project my thoughts telepathically, but I've never tried it on a dog before…
choice_data_list: I know you can make it work with all that lucky power you have!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Th-that's right! All the luck in the universe is with me!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Hnnngh! Doberoo, mastifoo, malamoo, ho… Labradoo, rottweiloo, spanieloo, go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I can't say if the telepathy worked, but about ten minutes later, Lucky walks close enough for us to grab hold of his leash.

text_block_list.name: Lucky
text_block_list.text: Whine…

text_block_list.name: Young Girl
text_block_list.text: Lucky! You're back! Thank you so much for the help!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: You're welcome. Hehe, guess we were quite lucky in finding him, huh?
choice_data_list: You are the Umamusume goddess of luck, after all.
You are the Umamusume goddess of luck, after all.

text_block_list.name: Young Girl
text_block_list.text: Really?! That's so cool!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Uh, well… Heh, hehehe! I wouldn't go that far…
choice_data_list: Praise be to the great Fukukitaru!

text_block_list.name: Young Girl
text_block_list.text: Praise be! Umm… Fukukitaru!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Hehe! Well, if you ever need any more help, leave it to me and my super-lucky powers to work things out!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Maybe I went a little too far with that bit… How embarrassing…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: It's just… I was so happy hearing all those compliments. Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Anyway, I'd say this outfit's lucky powers are now officially certified! It's definitely coming with me for my next race!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: You never know, maybe we'll meet that girl there!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: What?! You want some of my power?
choice_data_list: Please, I beg you! Just a smidge!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Hm… Even if you beg, I don't really know…
choice_data_list: I beseech thee, Goddess Matikanefukukitaru!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Hehe… Now, how could I say no to that?! Your wish is my command!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Okay! I'll just sprinkle a little bit of my power on this charm…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Nom, nom, hum, hum, doopee-dee! There you go!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: This charm here is a special one. With this, you'll always end up with a raffle-winning popsicle stick after finishing your icy treat!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: What an oddly specific power.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …All the same, I take my newly imbued charm for a test-drive and buy myself a popsicle.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: You won! Congratulations! Hehe, looks like my charm's working just as advertised, huh?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Woo! Another winner!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: And… another one?!

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text: There's no way we only have winners… That would be crazy…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Amid the confusion, a man wobbles into the store on the verge of collapse.

text_block_list.name: Man in Ragged Clothes
text_block_list.text: Please… give me… a popsicle…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Uh-oh… I'm sorry, but… we kinda just bought all of the popsicles…

text_block_list.name: Man in Ragged Clothes
text_block_list.text: You what?! Gyahhh! Thud.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Eek! A-are you okay?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Hurry, give him one of your popsicles!

text_block_list.name: Man in Ragged Clothes
text_block_list.text: Phew… I thought I was a goner. Please, let me repay your kindness…

text_block_list.name: Man in Ragged Clothes
text_block_list.text: In return for a popsicle… Yes, this will do.

text_block_list.name: Man in Ragged Clothes
text_block_list.text: Here, take this box. Thank you, and farewell.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: There he goes… What do you think is inside?
choice_data_list: Let's open it and see.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Wait a second, Trainer! What if this is a trap?! Like a Pandora's box situation!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: No way! A shiny blue smartphone?! And it's unopened!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Whaaat?! I-it's the newest model too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Don't tell me… The charm isn't limited to just popsicles, but anything that begins with the letter p, like "phone"!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Trainer, there is more to be done!
choice_data_list: What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: It only took one charm to get all this! Just imagine what would happen with two charms, or even three!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: This is a huge chance for us! Let's get a whole boatload of charms for you!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Let's see… If you have this charm, you'll never misplace your loose change! And this one helps you split disposable chopsticks perfectly!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: …Ugh, this is way too much trouble! Let's just get 'em all!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I trudge through town like some kind of decorated officer, covered head-to-toe in lucky charms. I'm not quite sure what my accomplishments are, however.
